scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @anchordesk/shared && npm run dev -w @anchordesk/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @anchordesk/shared && npm run dev -w @anchordesk/web
scripts.eval:retrieval: npm run db:test:reset && npm run eval:retrieval -w @anchordesk/api
scripts.eval:generation: npm run db:test:reset && npm run eval:generation -w @anchordesk/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @anchordesk/shared && npm run lint -w @anchordesk/api && npm run lint -w @anchordesk/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @anchordesk/shared && npm run build -w @anchordesk/shared && npm run typecheck -w @anchordesk/api && npm run typecheck -w @anchordesk/web && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:test:reset && npm run test:integration -w @anchordesk/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @anchordesk/shared && npm run build -w @anchordesk/api && npm run build -w @anchordesk/web
